# Vecmo

> Browser vector-motion editor (React 19 + Vite + Bun, AGPL-3.0-only + MIT layer). Local-first: `/` opens the editor, nothing in this build talks to a server. Exports self-contained runtime code, not video.

## Document formats

- Scene document: `src/entities/scene/model/serialization.ts` (`vector-motion-author.scene-document`, v2)
- Motion document: `src/entities/motion/model/serialization.ts` (`vector-motion-author.motion-document`, v1)
- Project backup (scene + motion + grammar bundle): `src/features/project-backup/model/project-backup.ts` (`vector-motion-author.project-backup`)

## MCP server

Entry point: `scripts/vma-agent-mcp.ts`, run as `bun run mcp:agent`, launched via `.mcp.json` (stdio). 26 typed tools over the scene/motion document.

Read/inspect (does not mutate the document): `observe_document`, `observe_node`, `observe_selection`, `observe_bridge_status`, `observe_document_live`, `observe_preview_state`, `load_reproduction_descriptor`, `list_artboards`, `list_layers`, `list_bindable_properties`, `list_appearance_effects`, `list_motion_grammar`, `list_look_graph`, `list_look_node_capabilities`, `run_validation`, `validate_edit_plan_live`, `propose_edit_plan` (plans a command set without applying it), `capture_editor_snapshot`, `export_artboard` (writes a file, not the document)

Write (mutates the scene/motion document): `apply_scene_commands`, `apply_motion_commands`, `apply_motion_grammar_commands`, `apply_document_commands`, `apply_camera_commands`, `apply_edit_plan_live`, `save_project_live`

Headless/scripted alternative to MCP: `bun run vmactl` (same command envelope; see `docs/agent-command-catalog.md`).

## Export profiles (Export -> Motion / Code)

Motion Artifact (EMBED, self-contained `<scene>.runtime.js`), Web Embed (compact, split data), Production (smallest, playback-only, shared `vector-motion-runtime.js`), Editable (full handoff bundle). Also: WebGL player, PDF, SVG, WebM, and a `.dctl` file for DaVinci Resolve Studio 18+ (Look Graph export).
